name: newsh2-89
summary: Purple armoured pod: a deep, boxy hard-surface hull with chamfered corners filling the block. The upper half is a caged armour box (a blue window at the top edge, a bar across row 5 and row 13, two raised side armour plates in bar frames, two vertical spine bars down the centre); a belt across the waist; the lower half is a recessed dark bay holding two round engine nacelles pointing back and a central keel of two ribs. Flat panels and crisp edges everywhere except the round nacelles.

concept.use: design guide; the sprite decides outline, proportions and colours

traits: boxy, hard-surface body with flat top and steep sides, chamfered top and bottom corners in the outline
deep: the upper half stands several px taller than a plate (a box, not a slab)
mid purple-grey, darker in the lower half
features.note: The armoured container itself. Its top view must fill the sprite's rounded-rectangle outline.

traits: blue glossy glass panel at the top edge, columns 9-15, rows 1-3
slightly raised in a housing, crisp edges
light cyan sill along its lower edge (row 3)
features.note: The viewport / sensor window at the front. Glass, not paint.

traits: two parallel vertical bars, columns 10-11 and 13-14, rows 5-16
constant cross-section, standing clearly above the armour
bright lilac with a lit top edge; dark groove (column 12) between them
features.note: The concept's two vertical metal bars of the cage; the brightest parts of the sprite.

traits: a horizontal bar across row 5 and another across row 13, columns 5-18
vertical frame bars at columns 5 and 18 joining them, framing the side plates
raised square-ish bars with crisp edges
features.note: The rectangular frame of bars around the side armour plates (concept).

traits: flat raised armour plate, columns 6-8, rows 6-12
lighter lilac (pal 90) than the hull, crisp edges
features.note: Left side armour panel inside its bar frame.

traits: flat raised armour plate mirroring the left one, columns 16-18
same colour as the left plate (the sprite's darker right side is shadow)
features.note: Right side armour panel inside its bar frame.

traits: round nacelle (a cylinder along the ship's length) about 4-5 px wide and as tall
ribbed housing, nozzle opening at the rear (bottom of the screen)
highlight near row 20 is sheen on the round housing, not a knob
features.note: Left engine in the lower bay.

traits: mirror of the left engine, same size and height
features.note: Right engine in the lower bay.

traits: a band across the hull at rows 14-16 where the upper box steps down to the lower bay
lit front edge at row 16 (columns 4-8 and 16-18)
features.note: The belt of plating between the armour cage and the engine bay.

traits: two raised ribs, columns 10-11 and 13-14, rows 17-24, between the engines
dark grooves (columns 9, 12, 15) are gaps cut down to the bay floor
features.note: The central keel plates between the two nacelles.
